nodes.html:
Looking for the perfect gift for the artist in your life? Show your love with a unique learning experience, lifetime memento, or year-long membership at Penumbra Foundation.

By gifting with Penumbra, you are making an impact. All proceeds from workshops, tintype sessions, memberships, and gift cards keeps our community thriving and sustains our public programs and free-to-apply opportunities.

This holiday season, give the perfect gift that also makes a difference.

nodes.caption: Image: After Hours: Mural Photograms with Roberto Huarcaya

nodes.html:
A unique learning experience. Gift a Workshop

At Penumbra, we offer over 175 in-person and online classes annually in:

  • Traditional and experimental darkroom

  • Photobooks

  • Portfolio development

  • Photographic history and theory

  • & more!

Show your love with an experience that sparks their creativity!

A memento that lasts a lifetime. Gift a Tintype Portrait

Tintypes are perfect for one-of-a-kind portraits.

It’s also a special way to commemorate life’s milestones, from anniversaries and birthdays to weddings and graduations.

Gift cards, redeemable for a later date, are also available!

nodes.caption: Image by Sam Dole, Penumbra Tintype Studio

nodes.html:
A Creative community. Gift a membership

Membership at Penumbra unlocks a range of benefits for artists, students, and educators based in NYC and abroad:

  • Discounts on classes

  • Access to facility rentals

  • Invitations to tours at galleries and fairs

  • Members-only open calls

  • & more!

Explore all membership options below and find the best fit for your loved one.

UNsure what to give?

You can never go wrong with a gift card!

Our gift cards are redeemable for workshop credit or any item in our shop.
